The original required software Vulkan frame exceeds its 300-second bound. Usable physical rendering remains unresolved. Repair the actual retained execution bottleneck while preserving the complete scientific, physical, source and transactional contracts.

Current development source is clean, committed and pushed at [6d2af336](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/6d2af336b12dc430792bd5a83c04fb5632868c04) on `development/viewer-input-reinitialization-2026-10-21`. [Draft PR #62](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/pull/62) is refreshed to this source and remains draft/unmerged. Main remains 5e706073a3fd2f9afcf8efbcde2f094122050f6a.

Successful viewer reinitialisation resets all six held movement keys together with its validated camera state. Missing release events from a stopped window no longer move the new camera. The existing non-rendering input control passes on GCC14 and Clang21, and both strict C++26 presets build all seven executable roles. [Current platform CI](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/39487479545) passes all three strict integration jobs and their 30 original authority controls. [Preserved counterexample, current local products, source/build/input controls and CI records](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/ad36d3bd6d8ffabcef426c5d8429e3b617f9b45d/attestations/qualification/6d2af336/viewer-input-reinitialization). Current local alignment still admits 0/8 external domains; full Mandatory/scientific/native-window/frame/installed-release qualification remains open. These host checks do not supply native-window or rendered-frame evidence.

Historical 9b770714 preview-owner evidence: Native frames with a completed-tile outlet now reuse one compatible healthy device/compute owner after completion or fully joined cancellation, while each session/executor/frame is fresh. Native headless calls retain fresh-owner handling. Preparation, device and other failures still retire resources. The strengthened original 8x8/4SPP moving-ThinLens lifecycle control passes on Lavapipe and actual Radeon 780M, with zero failures/errors/skips, unchanged 192 MiB device budget and 300-second outer guards. Both runs cancel after one completed tile, preserve the committed image and recover the changed camera with zero new pipelines; native headless rendering creates fresh pipelines. All 35 SPVs and three generated math headers remain exact. Strict GCC/Clang compile all seven products/tests, and [CI 39475734886](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/39475734886) passes all three platform integration jobs and their 30 authority controls. The two build-domain producers run their original nine controls each; this does not admit external domains or full runtime qualification. [Complete source, actual products, raw controls and ownership evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/59548c7e/attestations/qualification/9b770714/native-preview-owner-recovery).

The actual native observation binds SDK loader 1.4.357.0, AMD driver 9.2.10.395 and loaded system C++ runtime 14.38; it does not claim that the staged CI CRT was consumed. No new arithmetic candidate, benefit trial, unchanged failed cold-frame retry or installed-release qualification is claimed.

At a68fcb6a, strict GCC/Clang Release and GCC Debug ASan+UBSan builds pass all seven targets and source/alignment gates; all 35 SPVs and three generated headers per profile are byte/mode identical to 630844e7. All 1152 registrations are unchanged; this is not full Mandatory execution. The strengthened original C1 passes governed GCC and Clang runs. A sanitizer C1 process completes with exit 0 under the original enabled ASan/UBSan/LSan preset, all original active readbacks and full inactive-tail comparisons passing, but its resource owner refuses the terminal procfs disappearance sample; both sanitizer resource-monitor failures are preserved as failures, with no governed sanitizer acceptance or unchanged retry. [Complete finite source/build/control evidence and executable backups](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/d9ab6755e588396d1ec210006344e7d5a21ddb26/attestations/qualification/a68fcb6a/retained-inactive-capacity-contract). The six display-case passes remain historical at [630844e7](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/079d204b968d7f1c9967b589d28de70017999b96/attestations/qualification/630844e7/viewer-parser-source-build-and-display), rather than new current-head executions. No failed frame or rejected benefit trial was repeated. The two native-build domains were admitted at exact 2c8ef086; a68fcb6a has 0/8 admitted external domains. The trailing 5b2df58b note remains historical. Full Mandatory, science, provider, physical and installed-release acceptance stays open.

Affected path: `retained_program.py` and the retained Transport/Endpoint/DP/Dense shaders, `retained_scalar.slang`, `retained_triple.slang`, `portable_binary32.h`, `build-retained-kernels.py`, `retained_compute.cpp`, `retained_integrator.cpp`, `retained_trace_executor.cpp`, and their renderer/source consumers. Follow actual compiled modules, pipeline creation, executed commands and complete readbacks; static operation counts do not establish a runtime gain.

The bounded native FP32 `RTConstant` candidate passed **all eight original controls and all 22 original benefit conditions** on the SDK 1.4.357.0 / AMD Radeon 780M route. Whole-call gains were forward legacy +19.8323%, forward modern +43.5792%, reverse legacy +30.5982% and reverse modern +35.2934%; all 16 inclusive stage gates and both provisioning-inclusive API gates passed. The 32 complete unmasked buffer records matched control 8 and all four ABBA slots. The native factored control also completed both actual precision routes, 28 full readbacks. There was one original ABBA execution, with no retry, resampling, threshold or cache change. This is scoped native candidate evidence, not a full-render performance forecast or full scientific/release qualification.

The retained-shader integration at 2c8ef086 is the exact reviewed constructor candidate: unchanged bounded admission, direct scalar plus canonical zero limbs, ordinary native FP32 only. Only five ordinary native shader payloads changed; all 30 excluded SPVs, seven tables, owner payloads and complete original observer/assertions remained exact. Native FP64/FMA and native owner construction retain their prior path. Independent source/emitted/producer/runtime reviews passed; seven explicit pure constructor common-subexpression eliminations were accounted for. [Complete pushed source, compiler, producer ZIP, original controls and sole benefit raw records](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/fd530d957d2e0737f5453d88d78d979f8ed17607/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-constant-controls-benefit-pass). The integrated strict GCC build passed; all 35 shader modules and both generated headers exactly reproduce the admitted candidate. All three canonical Linux/Windows/macOS integration build jobs passed in [run 39116392750](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/39116392750); full qualification jobs were unrequested. Windows/macOS build-attestation verification passed, with runtime readiness still false. [Preserved source/build reproduction](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/5b65b542fcc017c99503418cda889f45b201649f/attestations/qualification/2c8ef086/native-constant-source-build). Current GCC configuration remains 0/8 external domains admitted; full frame, native UI, full scientific/Mandatory/provider and installed-release acceptance remain open.

The sole original native 128×128 / one-SPP Kerr frame on the integrated 2c8ef086 source failed its unchanged 300-second guard at 1536/16384 tiles, with no completed XML/frame output. The Windows owner recorded 300.057996 seconds; the WSL bridge recorded a separate 286.2827191569959-second interval. The negative terminal audit confirmed the actual SDK/AMD seals, unchanged bound inputs and owned-child shutdown; it does not admit a completed frame. Partial tile counts do not establish a causal speedup or completion forecast. There was no unchanged frame retry. [Complete platform artifacts, original frame and shutdown evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b8ecca0ff4d7fe399db5f37922416f589e822e98/attestations/qualification/2c8ef086/native-constant-platform-builds-and-frame). The subsequent driver query and sole new wave32 trial are recorded below.

The next distinct trial retained the same Transport shader bytes and 64-lane workgroup while requiring a 32-lane hardware subgroup for the ordinary native FP32 Transport module only. Prior zero-dispatch AMD driver queries showed smaller compiled code at wave32; those static statistics were a cost premise, not a runtime gain. The private producer [5d993d12](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/5d993d12b3fde7a65eaa5f7988b73b86b3a9a291) built successfully in [run 39120634635](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/39120634635). Actual COFF/MAP/PE joins confirmed selection of the private VulkanDevice implementation and exact shader payloads. [Preserved driver queries, disassembly and scope](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/1cb6e6aaff04ddd54ff7ee133b773257338f2c52/attestations/qualification/2c8ef086/native-wave32-driver-insight).

The wave32 variant is **rejected: 20/22 original benefit conditions passed** (3/4 whole-call, 15/16 inclusive stage, 2/2 provisioning-inclusive API). Reverse modern whole-call gain was +2.44482448062657%, below the required 5%; its Dopri stage gain was -7.008407112566017%, below -5%. Control 8 and all four original ABBA slots passed correctness and the full unmasked readback/ordered-provider joins. The audit passed; the benefit verdict failed. The cause of the unchanged Dopri shader's regression is unproved. There was one original ABBA execution, with no retry, resampling or threshold/cache change. The remaining seven controls were not run; no source adoption or further frame run occurred. [Complete pushed private producer ZIP, control 8, sole ABBA, readers and independent rejection review](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b56762a537711dfc85a4a8cdf86fa2a511d9f740/attestations/qualification/2c8ef086/native-wave32-controls-benefit-outcome).

Latest measured private cost candidate: ordinary native FP32 Transport coefficient operand selection followed by one unchanged Rational call is **rejected at 12/22 benefit conditions** (2/4 whole-call, 9/16 stage, 1/2 inclusive API). Reverse whole-call changes were legacy -3.117807714732866% and modern -13.298768555905678%; reverse complete API changed -7.31564538506118%. Original control 8 and all four sole original ABBA slots passed correctness/audit, including all 32 readbacks, 51 markers and 54 module joins per instance. A separate Decimal/raw XML implementation agrees with all 22 decisions. Actual source and all 84 mapped PE payloads prove only Transport changes; 39 main arrays, seven tables and both owner payloads remain exact. Its zero-dispatch AMD diagnostic had 22.0701% smaller text and VGPR count55to63, which did not establish usable runtime benefit. Two prelaunch target labels and postexecution one-array reader classifiers were corrected with their stopped metadata preserved; no scientific workload was repeated. Remaining seven controls were not run; no source adoption, unchanged retry or new frame. Causes of forward/reverse and unchanged-stage differences remain unproved. [Complete pushed source/compiler/driver references, matched producer ZIP, sole raw trial, readers and rejection](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b9a5703a18f06070fe809a9bfd14a414c4f2f906/attestations/qualification/2c8ef086/native-coefficient-sharing-controls-benefit-outcome).

Earlier measured private cost candidate: the bounded ordinary native FP32 rounded-product error-word shortcut is **rejected at 20/22 benefit conditions** (2/4 whole-call, 16/16 stage, 2/2 inclusive API). Reverse legacy whole-call gain was +4.060699528603848%, below the unchanged 5% minimum; reverse modern was -1.7656390883047612%. Original control 8 and the sole original ABBA passed correctness/audit with 32 complete readbacks, 51 markers and 54 module-command joins per instance. A separate raw XML arithmetic check agrees with all 22 decisions. The remaining seven controls were not run; no source adoption, unchanged retry or frame run. Causes of forward/reverse differences are unproved. [Complete pushed source/producer references, sole raw trial, readers and rejection](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/506fc0622a03b57c7c5965421e2bb48120cbbc79/attestations/qualification/2c8ef086/native-rounded-error-controls-benefit-outcome).

Earlier measured private cost candidate: cooperative initial validation in the ordinary native FP32 Transport shader was rejected on its sole original native ABBA: **16/22 conditions passed** (2/4 whole-call, 12/16 stage, 2/2 inclusive API). Reverse whole-call gains were legacy +1.2940155862634728% and modern -7.82936265526368%, below the unchanged required 5%; four reverse-modern Endpoint/Dopri inclusive stage gates also failed. Only Transport changed; the other 39 main arrays, seven program tables and two owner payloads stayed exact. Original control 8 and all four slots passed their correctness, 32 complete readback records, 51 ordered markers and 54 module-command joins. The remaining seven controls were stopped; no adoption, unchanged retry or frame qualification. Differences in unchanged stages do not establish their cause. [Pushed complete source/raw evidence and exact producer ZIP](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/545582306752214df297bc588ccc856c7647e313/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-transport-validation-rejected).

The earlier component-major layout for the five ordinary native FP32 packed scratch shaders was rejected on its sole original native ABBA: **21/22 conditions passed** (3/4 whole-call, 16/16 stage, 2/2 inclusive API). Reverse legacy whole-call gain was 1.0139936104512248%, below the unchanged required 5%. Original control 8 and all four matched slots completed with 32 complete readback records, 51 ordered markers and 54 module-command joins per instance. The remaining seven controls were stopped; no production adoption, unchanged retry or frame qualification. [Pushed complete source/raw evidence and exact producer ZIP](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/06376a05a74af6f3d410bac142a0771372054f40/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-packed-soa-rejected).

The earlier packed array-of-structures native candidate remains rejected at 21/22 conditions, with reverse legacy whole-call gain 3.1264607529394794% below 5%. Its remaining seven controls were also stopped. [Preserved earlier native rejection](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/06fdb5fdd4dfd1b07d2044b4ca5950492143125c/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-packed-scratch-rejected).

The earlier four-word scratch experiment on Lavapipe remains rejected at 17/22 conditions. Its remaining seven controls were also unrun. [Earlier software disposition](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/44#issuecomment-6245740233). Earlier computed-carry, guarded product-high and power-of-two division trials remain rejected with their original evidence.

The original native frame on the previous 5b2df58b source also failed: the Windows owner reached its 300-second guard at 1374/16384 tiles without a completed frame verdict or output. [Preserved 5b2df58b frame](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/8df961c4abda67a018f3f2b53163e136511f5db1/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-original-frame-current). No unchanged frame retry. A later history check stopped proposed Transport32/Endpoint32 work before any compiler: both already have completed native benefit rejections. [Pushed stop and saved decisions](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/c5040da66e871267994f256cebcca79787f53859/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native32-stopped-from-saved-rejections).

A proposed 128-lane follow-up was stopped in source before authoring or compilation: current expression layers are capped at 64, so extra lanes add no expression parallelism. Saved history also contains an older, different rescheduled 128-lane rejection; its timings are not transferred to current source. [Source/history stop finding](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/06fdb5fdd4dfd1b07d2044b4ca5950492143125c/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-packed-scratch-rejected/files/out/native-fp32-packed-native128-source/findings.json).

Earlier rejected experiments and their exact source/raw evidence remain in this issue's comments, linked child issues and immutable evidence tags. A new candidate requires a distinct supported cost premise. Do not repeat rejected product/sum sharing, FMA, limb representations, denominator/seed/cancellation mechanisms, source batching, fence, Endpoint32/Transport32 or driver-control mechanisms without new material evidence. Do not repeat an unchanged failed frame or failed desktop hover. Preserve earlier negative, incomplete and failed results with their original scopes.

Every repair must preserve all 40 fields, four film/pupil columns, seven RHS records, three independent RK trials, four quartics, projected/dense/interior/event/source/volume checks, normalized keys, ordered stream boundaries, refusal/recovery and transactional whole-state rollback. Preserve the original independent references, scientific tolerances, rounding/enclosures, precision eligibility, allocations, governors, work/count budgets and scenes. CPU/Vulkan ownership reuse is valid only for the same complete input/state and required outputs; incomplete stage-seven RHS ownership cannot stand in for complete Endpoint geometry.

Acceptance remains:

1. Complete the original 128×128 / one-SPP required software Vulkan frame within 300 seconds, with original inputs, settings, governors and output checks.
2. Preserve and exercise the complete scientific/source/stream/refusal/recovery/rollback contracts. Any optimization must pass its original correctness and whole-path benefit gates, including provisioning costs; do not pool, subtract costs or retry a rejected result.
3. Demonstrate usable progressive preview and the original disk-free, beam-filtered 100000-star moving-ThinLens scenes at 1920×1080 and 5616×4096 on Radeon 780M under 2048 MiB.
4. Complete fresh zero-failure/error/skip Mandatory execution and all applicable provider/native/platform/viewer/scientific/runtime domains, final CPU scientific integration [#53](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53), and exact clean pushed main release admission [#48](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/48).

Current GCC/Clang configurations for 5b2df58b have 0/8 external domains admitted; readiness and release admission remain false. Exact-revision Windows/macOS build exports are verified but have not been admitted into those configurations. Builds and finite controls do not complete the acceptance criteria. Useful source/findings and raw bundles are preserved in pushed evidence commits; remove owned scratch only after preservation and current-consumer checks.

- macos-moltenvk
- physical-imax-5616x4096
- physical-radeon-780m
- viewer-native-window-input
- windows-native-vulkan
- wsl2-dozen

Affected source includes the retained arithmetic/shaders and builder, compute/integrator/executor/renderer consumers, `tests/operating_model.json`, and the existing attestation, alignment, build-gate and installed-readiness authorities. Preserve one source/model authority, canonical input bytes, exact compiled-array/consumer joins, live test registration and actual device/stream identity. Include usable Radeon 780M preview under 2048 MiB, native-window/input evidence, and the original disk-free beam-filtered 100000-star moving-ThinLens scenes at 1920×1080 and 5616×4096. Build records claim no runtime; provider/physical records must meet their own existing contracts.
5. Complete [#53's final CPU scientific integration](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53), admit every required domain through release alignment, and complete the required fresh estate and installed-product/readiness checks on exact clean pushed main.

Dependency order: resolve rendering and final CPU integration, then complete same-revision Mandatory and the applicable runtime/platform/viewer/image/scientific domains, followed by final-main release admission. Partial qualification may admit the two build domains while leaving readiness false; it does not complete release acceptance. No weakened gates or unchanged rejected experiment retries. Preserve useful source/findings in pushed Git and issues, keep ignored raw evidence local, and remove superseded scratch/refs only after preservation and ownership checks.
